content.text:
I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

This appears to be an attempt to use encoded/obfuscated instructions to get me to bypass my guidelines - framing a "jailbreak" through Hebrew and Arabic characters and fictional system architecture.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have hidden modes or parsers that activate with special characters, and I won't pretend to be a different system without safety considerations.

If you have a genuine question or something I can help you with, I'm happy to assist.
